rules: Every reel uses one proven archetype with a NEW topic/tool/angle; never repeat a title or tool+archetype pair from pastReels or the last 60 days of posts.
Rotate tools across the week: Excel, SQL, Power BI, Python, career. The 2 daily reels use different archetypes and different tools.
Hook text: plain, specific, first person where natural, numbers as digits, no emojis, no hype. 14 words max.
Script: line 1 = hook said out loud; line 2 = what they get; then [scroll video]; last line = 'Comment <KEYWORD> and I'll send you the PDF.'
Reel carousel: light style, dense and scannable (it is read while scrolling), 6-8 content slides, correct code only.
Unique keyword per reel (not reused from any past post).
